scientific_integrity: Mathematical derivation reconstructs exact finite jump rates, harmonic absorption probabilities, and normal-limit scaling; finite arithmetic tests supplement rather than establish the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only binary noise-free nonlinear-voter unanimity dynamics with panel sizes two or three on complete networks, with neighbor draws with replacement. Publication priority has not been independently certified; other formulations may be prior art.
title: A sharp finite-size consensus gap between two mean-field-identical nonlinear voter rules
